# Turn JSON into TypeScript, Zod, JSON Schema or Go

> Convert JSON to TypeScript interfaces, Zod schemas, JSON Schema or Go structs. Merges many samples to find optional and nullable fields. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How to type an API response safely](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/json-to-types-generator/how-to-type-an-api-response.html)
